notes: Use exact text-node matches only inside safe selectors; never translate element textContent wholesale.
Exclusions apply to text and user-entered values. Input placeholder attributes may be translated separately; never translate input value.
Breadcrumbs, file/folder names, paths, archive filenames, and search queries are excluded even when equal to a dictionary key.
Fragments for counts and limits are included for static split text nodes; interpolated messages need scoped anchored patterns or explicit Vue render handling.
Public bundles inspected for static labels. Recently deleted, populated file lists, and many error dialogs were not captured live.
Do not use the short fragments as global substring replacements; dynamic file-info size/date labels need dedicated text-node handlers preserving their values.
